item.title: Proposed Trade Has Lakers Parting Ways With Rui Hachimura For Patrick Williams
item.description: The framework would send Rui Hachimura, along with guard Gabe Vincent, to the Chicago Bulls in exchange for Patrick Williams and Ayo Dosunmu.

item.title: ESPN Los Angeles Radio Host Says Klay Thompson Wants To Retire As A Laker
item.description: ESPN Los Angeles radio host John Ireland now suggests that if Klay finds a way out of Dallas, the Lakers would make a lot of sense as his preferred destination and possibly the place where he finishes his career.

item.title: Dwyane Wade And Marquette's Unforgettable NCAA Tournament Run In 2003
item.description: During the magical 2002-03 NCAA season, Dwyane Wade led the Marquette Golden Eagles on a captivating and unexpected journey through the NCAA Tournament, capturing the hearts of basketball fans with his dazzling skills, leadership, and clutch performances.

item.title: Dwyane Wade Recalls Amazing Michael Jordan Story From His Rookie Season
item.description: Dwyane Wade recalled an incredible Michael Jordan story from his rookie season. Even though he was injured, Wade was so eager to play against his childhood hero, that he had to pay the price afterwards. Check it out.

item.title: The Quesarito Peace Treaty: Nikola Jokić Finally Bites Back
item.description: In the years that followed his draft, Nikola Jokić leaned into it with the dry humor that makes him such an unlikely superstar brand, at various points saying he’d never eaten Taco Bell. That has now changed!

item.title: The Orange Band That Didn’t Come Off: Anthony Edwards' Promise To Luca
item.description: In early January 2025, Anthony Edwards met a 6-year-old fan named Luca who was battling leukemia. Luca handed Edwards an orange wristband that read “Love Like Luca.” A lot changes in a year in the NBA. The orange band didn’t.

item.title: Jerry West's Game-Winning Jumper in the 1972 NBA All-Star Game
item.description: The 1972 NBA All-Star Game that took place 54 years ago today, stands as a testament to Jerry West's legendary ability to rise to the occasion when the pressure was at its peak. Check it out.

item.title: “Not Real Basketball,” Real Respect: Stephen Curry And The Night Charlotte Tried To Erase Him
item.description: Charlotte tried to delete Stephen Curry on Saturday, and Curry’s postgame response was the most honest summary of what it feels like to be defended as an idea instead of a player.

item.title: A Classic In San Antonio: Spurs-Wolves, And A Rivalry That Feels Like The Next Decade
item.description: Spurs-Wolves on Saturday night was a 126–123. It also felt like a trailer. Anthony Edwards and Victor Wembanyama combined for 94 points (55 and 39), trading haymakers across styles, positions, and eras.

item.title: “That Looks Like Wendell”: London, Desmond Bane, Wendell Carter, And A Bulldog
item.description: The Orlando Magic are in London for part two of the Global Game Series in Europe. Upon arriving in the UK, Desmond Bane cracked up teammates during a team media setting by joking that a bulldog looked like Wendell Carter Jr.
